lines: Eel-Catcher Gunn: Aart checks the stilts every morning. Sadly they keep holding him up.
Eel-Catcher Gunn: The eels came back to the stilts. They know when the water's right.
Stilt-Builder Aart: They say my stilts wobble. They don't wobble. I wobble. Out of sheer shame.
Stilt-Builder Aart: No wobble in weeks. The Rift shook more than the storm ever did.
Reed-Cutter Wenna: I sleep all evening so I don't have to listen to Hanne sell fish she found under a stilt.
Reed-Cutter Wenna: The reeds grow so fast now I can't keep up. A nice problem.
Fishwife Hanne: My fish is fresh. Fresher than Gunn's jokes, anyway. Those died before the Rift.
Fishwife Hanne: Folk buy fish again without sniffing it twice. The Rift scared them off the lake.
